description: How a line of human output, and an alert, show a name, a logical path: as it is when it is valid UTF-8 with no control character, of the general category Cc, and no format character, Cf, which may reorder what follows it or hide itself; otherwise as (base64) and a space, then its bytes in standard base64. The format characters are those of Unicode 17.0.0, the version of the tables of Go 1.27 (unicode.Version): the cases with from and to give them, every range in order, and no other character is one. The --json outputs and the log are not this: they hold path, or path_b64 for bytes that are not valid UTF-8 (§29.3).

cases.note: ASCII, its spaces and brackets: as it is
an accented letter, in NFC: as it is
the same name in NFD: U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT is Mn, as it is

U+E000, a private use character, is Co: as it is
U+2065, between the isolates, is unassigned in Unicode 17.0.0 (Cn): as it is, until a version of Unicode makes it Cf
